title: Input samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the input samplesheet CSV

work_path.description: Path to the working folder in the cellprofiller-resuts bucket. Ex (IRIC/Phenotypic_screen_HY-L022-custom_U2OS/Subset1_10uM_Run01/)
work_path.help_text: This is used dynamically to determine where the container mounts and where the final HTML/CSV files are saved.

image_folder.description: Path to the full Image folder of the given plate timepoint from the /mnt/ugreen_nas_v(1,2 or 3)/folder. Ex (arctoris/Saguaro_Live Cell Paint/MISN.008_LiveCP_HEPG2_DAPI__2026-02-07T20_33_37-Measurement 7/Images)
image_folder.help_text: Must match the exact directory name where the raw TIFFs/PNGs are stored.

plate.help_text: Used to route the CellProfiler outputs and plot titles.

time.help_text: Represents the hour of the scan.

single_cell.description: Flag to enable single-cell embedding extraction.
single_cell.help_text: Set to 'true' or '1' to pass the --single_cell flag into the GPU Cellpose script.
